{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-07-31T14:34:19+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Rico, I can't believe you let her take the sub out at night."}

{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-07-31T14:34:37+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Oh, Mija. I'm sorry. That mission already left last night."}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-07-31T14:34:39+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Besides, the Lower Depths are too dangerous."}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-07-31T14:34:40+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "You can do so much good right here!"}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-07-31T14:34:41+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Sun's almost up. Let's get you started with your first job."}

event_data: {"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:08:39+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "With your help, we might actually be able to get the Kelp Refuge up and running!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:08:41+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Your sister used to love this place. I can't think of a better way to honor her."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:08:43+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "What about the other research stations? Do they need help, too?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:08:46+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "For now, I'd rather have you stay closer to home. Just in case."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:08:48+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Never mind, Sweetie. Let's get you set up with your next job!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:08:49+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Talk to me to view your Job Board whenever you're ready."}
{"node_id": "partner.talk.help.noJob.default.2", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:09:13+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "V1ctor, any words of wisdom? I'm a bit stuck."}
{"node_id": "partner.talk.help.noJob.default.2", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:09:15+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I wonder if there are any jobs available for us to take..."}
{"node_id": "interior.job.kelp.jobGiver.noJob.a", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:09:19+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Would you like to see the Job Board, Mija?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.start", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:09:35+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Okay, Mija. You already identified all the species here at Site C."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.start", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:09:37+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Now you'll need to head to Site A, Rodeo Cove, and do the same thing."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.helpWrongSite", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:10:04+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "According to my data, you've taken a job at a different site."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.helpWrongSite", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:10:06+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "You need to surface and navigate your ship to Site A."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:11:10+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Wow, Rodeo Cove! My sister used to bring me here when I was little."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:11:14+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I wonder if Ovid the Otter still lives here. He was my favorite."}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:11:16+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "According to my database, male sea otters live an average of 10 to 15 years in the wild..."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:11:19+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "So there is a 15.8% chance that Ovid is still alive!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:11:21+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Gee. Thanks for that cheery thought, V1ct0r."}

{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.partner.onScan.probeHackerNotAcquired.2", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:12:13+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Looks like we'll need some new equipment if we're going to scan these probes."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.helpDoExperiment.InExperiment", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:12:59+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Is anything interacting with the Bull Kelp?"}

{"node_id": "partner.talk.experiment.behavior.idle.nothingLeft.2", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:13:36+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "You've been pretty thorough here! I doubt we'll learn anything more from this experiment."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.argue.introQuestion", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:14:02+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Wonderful, Mija! And you're back so soon!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.argue.introQuestion", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:14:04+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "What behaviors did you learn about Bull Kelp in Site A?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.argue.done", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:14:15+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Just like here at the Forested Lagoon, Sea Otters eat the Urchins."}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:14:18+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "You've proven that both Bull Kelp and Giant Kelp provide energy to their ecosystems."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:14:20+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Does that mean I can take a job at another station?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:14:21+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Well... if that's what you really want."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:14:23+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "But are you sure you don't want to stay here? You're still so new at this."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:14:24+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "No te preocupes, Mom. I'll be careful."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:14:26+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I'll have V1ct0r update the map aboard your AquaLab."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:14:27+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "In the meantime, stop by your uncle's shop. You'll need some upgrades."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-shop-welcome.helpGetTagger", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:14:52+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Talk to your uncle. He'll have some items for you!"}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:15:01+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "What do you think of V1ct0r? Pretty sweet A.I., right?"}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:15:02+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "His love of data was Mer's idea."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:15:05+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "\u00a1Claro que s\u00ed! Didn't I tell you?"}

{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.ContinueAfterTioVictorJournal", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:15:13+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Now that you and V1ct0r will be traveling outside the Kelp Forest, you'll need some upgrades."}

{"node_id": "interior.job.kelp.jobGiver.noJob.a", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:18:33+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Would you like to see the Job Board, Mija?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.start", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:18:44+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Okay, Olivia, I've got something a little different for you this time."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.start", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:18:47+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I need you to create a model of Site C's food web."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.start", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:18:48+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Use the Modeling Lab on your ship to create a food web model for the Forested Lagoon."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.start", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:18:50+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I would do it myself, but our funders have been calling me all day."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.start", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:18:51+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "And I should probably check on Osa the Otter... he was looking a little ragged."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.start", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:18:54+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Are you doing okay, Mom? You sound a little--"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.start", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:18:56+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "You just focus on your work. Leave all the stressful stuff to me."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.catchFoodWeb", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:20:01+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "We need to create a Visual Model of the Forested Lagoon."}
{"node_id": "modeling.generic.visual-model.intro", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:20:09+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "We've gathered a bunch of facts about what eats what in the ecosystem."}

{"node_id": "modeling.generic.visual-model.intro", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:20:11+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "We can combine those facts into a Visual Model. That can help us see how they fit together."}

{"node_id": "modeling.generic.visual-model.intro", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:20:14+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Make sure to select the ecosystem that matches the current job and click on the Visualize tab to get started."}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.generic.visual-model.opened", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:20:27+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Click the Import New Facts button to bring all of your facts about this ecosystem into the model."}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.generic.visual-model.imported", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:20:37+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "This is a visual model of all the species at the Forested Lagoon."}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.generic.visual-model.imported", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:20:46+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "The arrows show relationships that your experiments have uncovered."}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.generic.visual-model.imported", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:20:48+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "In a Food Web, arrows point toward the species doing the consuming."}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.generic.visual-model.imported", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:20:50+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "If your Visual Model meets all the requirements of your job, you will be able to save it to AQOS."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.modelingComplete", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:20:56+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "You've created a Visual Model! Your work is acceptable!"}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.modelingComplete", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:20:59+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "You know, V1ct0r... I mean this in the nicest possible way, but not all humans think of \"acceptable\" as a compliment."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.modelingComplete", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:21:07+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I have an onboard Thesaurus, if you'd like me to improvise."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.modelingComplete", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:21:13+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Never mind, V1ct0r. You're perfect. You do you."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.modelingComplete", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:21:15+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Let's head to the station. I need to report back to Mom."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.argue.hello", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:21:44+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Oh, don't worry, Sweetie. I'm sure she'll be okay."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.argue.hello", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:21:47+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Let me worry about all that. I want to hear about your job!"}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.argue.chooseEnergy", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:21:50+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "According to your Food Web, what is the source of energy in the Forested Lagoon?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-energy.argue.chooseEnergy", "server_time": "2026-07-31T15:21:51+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "What is the thing that is consumed, but doesn't consume anything else?"}
